title: Functoriality, colimit and reduction properties of the maximal weakly etale subalgebra
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma fixes a field K and, for a K-algebra A, writes B_max(A) for the maximal weakly etale K-subalgebra, and then asserts a list of structural properties: functoriality under a K-algebra map A' -> A; agreement with the intersection B_max(A) cap A' when A' is a subalgebra of A; commutation with filtered colimits; invariance under reduction; and multiplicativity over finite products (source lines 30912-30930). The proof derives these from the defining property of B_max(A) as the subalgebra generated by the images of all weakly etale maps into A, checking in each case that the subalgebra produced on the left satisfies the universal property defining the right-hand side (proof span). The non-routine content is the colimit and reduction statements, where one must show that the relevant weakly etale maps factor through the appropriate intermediate algebra.
